sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair owner/path modeling and formula comparison: framingAngleOmega and iceLoadRequiredNetPlateThickness are declared on plating, and frameSpacing is declared on structuralMember, so do not constrain or join them directly on the ship. Target the required ship but traverse the necessary canonical component/member paths so the omega, hull-area classification, t_net, and associated operands apply to the same plating case and its structural member, avoiding unpaired cross-products among arbitrary ship members.
